summary_md: **Peasant Smith ([@PeasantSmith](https://x.com/PeasantSmith/status/2115598767206621295))** explains Project Maya's **loop guard**, a mechanism to stop a local model from repeating itself during generation; the X article links the mw00/project-maya GitHub repo.
relevance: A practical harness-side fix for a common failure mode of small local models in agent loops.
